explication: gpb is an Erlang compiler for Google Protocol Buffers. The documented user workflow is to provide a .proto definition, invoke the protoc-erl command-line tool to generate Erlang source and header files, compile the generated module, then encode and decode messages in Erlang. The tree also shows parser, compiler, code-generation, JSON, verification, translation, and NIF subsystems. Their detailed call relationships are not established by the excerpts, so those links are omitted; documented workflow edges cite the README.
